title: Dispatch: 19.4.6 restructure to the approved keep-typed/DM-adjudicated triage (attempt 4)
description: User decision 2026-10-12 (bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent, READ IT FIRST): keep a non-effect magic-item structure TYPED only where a positive engine capability is likely soon; otherwise it is DM-ADJUDICATED (no typed representation; executionReadiness clause readiness adjudicated-by-design with a VERBATIM sourceText span). This replaces further narrow repair of review eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.5 (read it in full: S1-S4) - the S1/S2 classes hit the two-repair hard stop and the user chose this structural rule instead. APPLY THE TRIAGE ACROSS THE WHOLE CORPUS: (1) KEEP typed and EXACT: operation ids and economy cost bindings and effect refs; economies (charges/uses/per-day/cooldowns/resets) - fix S3 by adding an exact event-anchor representation for cooldowns whose wait starts at a printed termination event (Ring of Djinni Summoning departure, Wings of Flying disappearance, Efreeti Bottle stopper sequence; sweep for siblings), leaving initiation-anchored ones as is; activation action type (action/bonus-action/reaction) only where printed; equipment prerequisites as a NEW STRUCTURED activation field (e.g. equipment: ['worn'|'held'|'attuned'|'on-person'], validated in packages/core/src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts and kindSchemas) derived from the printed text (Helm of Brilliance ignite-weapon: worn; Hammer of Thunderbolts Giant's Bane: attuned at property level; staffs/wands/rods held; etc.); state machines needed by the 19 executable (green) operations plus simple active/inactive toggles with a printed duration/termination; entity-grant creature refs/count/duration/reversion (0 HP, duration end, conjure-elemental concentration exception). (2) MAKE DM-ADJUDICATED (remove the typed field, add an adjudicated clause with the verbatim governing span): all free-text activation requirement/trigger/target strings except those mapped to the structured equipment field (sight, range, size, contest, aboard, remover designation, movement caps, ...) - this disposes S1 c/d; complex state topology (Apparatus of the Crab levers, Eversmoking Bottle, Dancing Sword, Broom of Flying, Carpet, Decanter, etc. - anything beyond a simple toggle not needed by a green op) - disposes S2; grant control/obedience/exclusivity/revert-policy text (Pipes of the Sewers contest, Staff of the Python 'on your turn', Iron Flask invented exclusivity removed) - disposes S4; containment, spellStore, rollManipulation blocks. Keep the verbatim-span invariant over every adjudicated clause. RUNTIME SAFETY: the readiness comparison over all item/variant/operation combinations must keep the same 19 ready operations; check toolUseItem, toolSpendUsage, toolResetUsage, toolRestoreUsage, itemState, itemResetExecutor, usageCounters, itemRandomInitialization, magicItemVariants, discovery before removing anything; never remove a field a green operation needs. Capability beads that will consume the kept fields (do not implement them here; keep shapes they can bind to): eshyra-olc5.8 (event-anchored cooldowns), .9 (turn-resource spend), .10 (equipment prerequisites), .11 (active-state durations), .12 (item-granted creatures). Evidence: replace screens that certified free text with (a) exactness checks on the kept typed fields (action type printed, equipment derived from printed text, anchors) and (b) a whole-corpus assertion that the DM-adjudicated categories carry no typed predicate fields and every adjudicated clause has a verbatim span; representative eligible/ineligible scenarios per kept category; keep earlier source-backed regressions that still apply, retire ones whose typed field is now intentionally absent (say which, per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md). Update the registry/inventory text describing these blocks truthfully. Regenerate pack (npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1) and inventory; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack. Importer protocol. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes: per-category table (kept vs adjudicated counts), S1-S4 disposition, readiness comparison, retired assertions; close this bead. No push/PR.
notes:
COMPLETE at commit 3a4e587a (branch eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.6, not pushed). verify:worktree green (359 files / 6717 tests), verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exact, inventory regenerated (1926 -> 1852 rows), typecheck clean.
READINESS: same 19 ready operations before/after (recomputed over 1049 item/variant/op combinations; Ammunition hit-target, Boots of Levitation cast-levitate, Candle burn, 14 Ioun Stone grab-orbiting-stone, Ring of Shooting Stars discharge-ball-lightning, Rope of Entanglement escape-rope). Withholding a block initially freed 66 operations; each withheld block's bound ops now keep one operation-bound engine-pending clause with the block's hooks (+78 backlog candidates).
PER-CATEGORY (kept typed / adjudicated): operation ids+cost bindings+economies: kept all (362 ops). Activation: 264 cost + 48 commandWord kept; 122 ops get structured equipment (78 held, 38 worn, 3 attuned, 3 on-person); ALL free-text requirement(197)/trigger(51)/target(41)/note(4) removed -> whole-sentence adjudicated clauses (Talisman 'wearing or holding' alternative stays adjudicated). State machines: 49 -> 24 typed (simple toggles + Ioun Stone, Rope of Entanglement, Ring of Shooting Stars [green-bound] + Cube of Force [itemResetExecutor timer + campaign-rule ambiguity consumer]); 25 withheld. Grants: 17 blocks kept (16; Orb of Dragonkind withheld, no creature ref) with only id/kind/refs/count/duration/revertOn/cooldownEconomy + 'as spell:conjure-elemental' pointer; control/exclusiveInstance/onEntityDeath/note stripped (all adjudicated). Containment 10 -> 1 (Iron Flask minimal occupancy). spellStore 9 scopes -> 3 numeric cores. rollManipulation 7 items -> 0. Adjudicated clauses 110 -> 333.
S1-S4: S1 a Helm ignite worn (+held-weapon sentence), b Hammer giant-slaying attuned, c Shackles + d Shooting Stars move: targets/limits now adjudicated verbatim, no typed claim. S2 a-d Apparatus/Eversmoking/Dancing Sword/Broom machines withheld. S3 cooldown.startsOn {grant-ended|state-entered}: Djinni (grant particular-djinni), Wings (state inactive), Efreeti new 'stopper' economy anchored to serving-efreeti; sweep: Frost Brand, Horn of Valhalla, Rod of Security, Well of Many Worlds are initiation-anchored (asserted against printed sentences); Figurine cooldowns are untyped notes -> adjudicated. S4 Pipes/Python/Iron Flask control+exclusivity stripped, full conditional sentences adjudicated.
RETIRED ASSERTIONS (each typed field intentionally absent; source claim kept as verbatim-span assertion): activation requirement/trigger/target value tests (operation agreement, effect agreement Gloves/Arrow/Orb/Dust/Cubic Gate), withheld-machine graph tests (Dancing Sword, Decanter, Broom, Eversmoking, Rope of Climbing, Instant Fortress, Apparatus, Sphere, Iron Bands, Pigments, Folding Boat), grant control/note tests, containment overflow/rupture tests, spellStore event-cost test, sight cohort (9 records leave typed cohort), Ring of Elemental Command stateMachine pin, magic-item#prose-only now 2 accepted records. Numeric-conservation gate: 6 DC exceptions added with rationale (precedent: Apparatus/goat of terror).
CANDIDATES TO SURFACE TO THE USER (deviations from the table; consumer evidence): (1) spellStore kept as numeric core (capacity/initialLevels/operationIds) for Ring of Spell Storing, Ioun Reserve, Rod of Absorption because randomProcedure initial-stored-levels binds to it (itemState createInitialItemState threw otherwise); schema required fields relaxed for spell-storage/spell-energy. (2) Iron Flask containment minimal (mode, tracksOccupancy, capacity 1) for itemRandomInitialization. (3) Cube of Force machine kept (timer executor + ambiguity). (4) Equipment cannot state alternatives (wearing OR holding) - Talisman stays adjudicated; if olc5.10 needs any-of, the shape must change. (5) Ring of Elemental Command base->unlocked machine withheld.
NOTHING UNFINISHED. No source-agreement category looked unlikely to converge.
